title: Valve mechanically stuck
summary: The valve is commanded but does not move; its position feedback contradicts the command.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: The valve is commanded but does not move; its position feedback contradicts the command.

troubleshooting.effect: Process does not react; possible overflow or dry run
symptoms: Command TRUE, position stays closed (or the reverse)
Feedback alarm after the travel time
diagnosticMethod: Compare command and feedback over time
Check air or power supply to the actuator
Operate the valve manually if safe
repair: Add feedback supervision to the program
troubleshooting.explanation: Without feedback supervision the PLC cannot know that a commanded valve did not move.
